faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: We've gathered the most common questions. If you still have any, just reach out.

q1.question: How does the consultation work?
q1.answer: The first appointment lasts about 60 minutes. We do a full anamnesis, physical assessment with bioimpedance and, within 5 business days, you receive your personalized meal plan as a PDF.

q2.question: How long does the follow-up last?
q2.answer: It depends on your goal. On average we recommend at least 3 months for consistent results. Many patients continue for 6 to 12 months.

q3.question: Do you accept health insurance?
q3.answer: We don't work directly with insurance, but we issue receipts for reimbursement. Check with your provider about coverage for nutritionist appointments.

q4.question: How does online consultation work?
q4.answer: Online consultations are held by video call (Google Meet or Zoom), with the same duration and quality as in-person. You receive the meal plan as a PDF by email afterwards.

q5.question: How is the meal plan built?
q5.answer: The plan is 100% personalized, considering your exams, routine, food preferences, restrictions and goals. It includes a substitution list for day-to-day flexibility.

q6.question: How many return appointments are needed?
q6.answer: We recommend weekly returns in the first month and biweekly from the second month on. Everything is adjusted based on your progress.

q7.question: Which regions do you serve?
q7.answer: The office is located in São Paulo, with easy access. For clients in other cities or states, we offer 100% online service with the same quality.

q8.question: Can I pay in installments?
q8.answer: Yes. We accept credit cards (up to 6x interest-free), PIX, bank slip and wire transfer.
